item.title: India Rejects Claims After PM Modi’s Name Appears in US Epstein Files
item.description: India on Friday firmly dismissed any suggestion of wrongdoing after Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s name appeared in a reference within newly released files of the United States Justice Department linked to the late financier Jeffrey Epstein. item.title: Sitharaman to Present Union Budget for Ninth Consecutive Time Today
item.description: Nirmala Sitharaman will present the Union Budget for 2026–27 in the Lok Sabha today as Parliament continues its Budget Session. item.title: Five Shots Fired Outside Bollywood Director Rohit Shetty’s House in Mumbai
item.description: Five rounds of gunfire were reported outside the Juhu residence of filmmaker Rohit Shetty in the early hours of Sunday in Mumbai, triggering a security alert in the area. The incident occurred between 12.40 am and 1 am, police officials said. No injuries were reported in the firing. Shetty was present at home when the shots were fired, according to reports. item.title: Purthimi Akemang 2.0 Brings Land Rights to 3,157 Families in Karbi Anglong
item.description: More than 3,000 landless families in West Karbi Anglong received long-awaited land ownership documents on Saturday as the Karbi Anglong Autonomous Council (KAAC) distributed free land pattas under its flagship “Purthimi Akemang 2.0” scheme. item.title: January GST Mop-Up Hits Rs 1.93 Lakh Crore, Up 6.2%
item.description: India’s Goods and Services Tax (GST) collections remained strong in January, offering a steady signal on the health of the economy as revenues rose on the back of firm domestic demand and robust imports. According to official data, gross GST collection in January stood at Rs 1.93 lakh crore, marking a 6.2 per cent increase compared to the same month last year.
